fixed.summary: A text's pseudo-element styles draw: ::first-letter, ::first-line, ::before and ::after colours, fonts and decorations were replaced by the element's plain style once its CSS fields applied. ::first-letter takes the first letter, number or symbol with the Unicode punctuation around it (“¿Q, (1)) and a base with its combining marks, as CSS Pseudo-Elements 4 §2.2 says; it took only ASCII punctuation before a single character.
